name: smwmusic-touhou-eiyashou-imperishable-night-love-colored-master-spark-stage-clear-mix
title: Touhou Eiyashou ~ Imperishable Night - Love-Colored Master Spark (Stage-Clear-Mix)
description:
Did a short arrangement of Love-Colored Master Spark (from Touhou 8 Eiyashou ~ Imperishable Night) as a "stage-clear-mix." Shoutouts to Marisa Kirisame fans. Gotta be some of the most passionate simps for a woman like her.

Note:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ♠ You will need to add ! to the line "default/0D SMW @14.brr" in Addmusic_sample_groups.txt for it to sound as intended in-game if you plan to use this as a global song.

Important:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. F Minor (Remix Pitch) [turned on by default]
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ2. F# Minor (Original Pitch)

There are also customizable options for enabling & disabling the goal tape sound that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. Enables Goal SFX [turned on by default]
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ2. Disables Goal SFX
